Added `functools.lru_cache` to `compute()` in `compute.py:3` so repeated calls with the same `n` skip recomputation — return value is unchanged, and `_calls` still increments only on actual (cache-miss) computation, preserving the existing behavior contract. Added `test_compute.py` covering correctness, cache-hit dedup, and independent caching per distinct argument.

One thing worth flagging: I only committed source code as instructed, so no tests were executed — you'll want to run `pytest test_compute.py` to confirm.
